facts.fact: Square supports more than 4 million businesses, according to the Square partnership Q&A on Universal Ads' blog.
facts.quote: Today, Square supports more than 4 million businesses from global chains to small mom-and-pop shops.

facts.fact: Square merchants will receive $500 in Universal Ads ad credits to test and experiment with streaming advertising, per Universal Ads' Sean Friedland.
facts.quote: Square merchants will receive $500 in Universal Ads ad credits that can be used to test and experiment with streaming advertising
